blocks.text: Bohat se janwaron mein baalon ka rang epistasis se control hota hai, jis mein aik gene doosre par asar dalta hai. Misaal: Labrador kutton mein baalon ka rang (kaala, bhoora, peela) do genes par munhasir hai:

items: B gene pigment ka rang tay karta hai. Dominant allele B kaala rang aur recessive b bhoora rang deta hai. Is liye BB ya Bb kaala aur bb bhoora hota hai.

E gene baalon mein pigment jama hone (deposition) ko control karta hai. Dominant E pigment jama hone deta hai, lekin recessive e (ee ki soorat mein) B ya b par epistatic hai aur baalon mein pigment jama nahi hone deta. Is liye EE ya Ee wale kutton ke baalon mein rang hota hai, lekin ee wale kutte peele hote hain, chahe B ho ya b.

blocks.alt: Oopar: kaala, bhoora aur peela Labrador aur un ke genotypes: kaala BBEE, BBEe, BbEE ya BbEe; bhoora bbEE ya bbEe; peela BBee, Bbee ya bbee. Neeche: do kaale BbEe kutton ka cross; 4 x 4 grid (oopar sperm BE, Be, bE, be, baen eggs) har bachche ka genotype aur rang deta hai: 9 kaale, 3 bhoore, 4 peele.

blocks.long_description: Grid ki qataarein (eggs) BE, Be, bE, be; har khane mein genotype aur Black, Brown ya Yellow likha hai.

blocks.text: Jab do heterozygous kaale kutton (BbEe × BbEe) ka cross kiya jaye to bachche kaale, bhoore aur peele 9:3:4 ratio mein hote hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Grid mein har woh khana jis mein ee hai peela hai (4 khane), chahe B ho ya b. Baqi mein B_ wale kaale (9) aur bb wale bhoore (3). Is tarah 9:3:3:1 ke aakhri do hisse (3 + 1) mil kar 4 peele ban jate hain: 9 : 3 : 4.

blocks.title: Bombay phenotype
blocks.text: ABO genotypes ka zahir hona aik aur gene H par bhi munhasir hai. Yeh gene aik khaas H substance banata hai, jo A ya B antigens ka pehla maadda (precursor) hai. Alleles Iᴬ aur Iᴮ aise enzymes banate hain jo H substance ko antigen-A aur antigen-B mein badalte hain. Agar kisi ke paas Iᴬ aur Iᴮ alleles hon lekin us ka genotype hh ho to woh H substance nahi banata. Is liye us ke Iᴬ aur Iᴮ alleles A aur B antigens nahi bana pate, aur A aur B antigens na hone ki wajah se us ka phenotype O hota hai. Ise Bombay phenotype kehte hain kyunke yeh 1952 mein Bombay mein daryaft hua. Yeh zyada tar India, Bangladesh, Pakistan aur Iran mein milta hai.
